messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Dependency alert: elevated error-rate & timeouts from cloud KMS endpoints (kms.googleapis.com & kms.amazonaws.com) detected for 25m. Correlated with service startup failures in prod us clusters. Paging oncall.
Priya: oncall here, ack. Seeing auth-bootstrap loops: pods fail init while fetching signing material from KMS; stacktrace shows grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and occasional 502/503.
Zane: logs snippet: ```
2026-10-05T21:02:11Z auth-init ERROR fetch_signing_key attempt=1 err=rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
2026-10-05T21:02:37Z auth-init WARN received HTTP 502 from kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
2026-10-05T21:02:58Z kubelet BackOff restarting failed container
``` 
Mei: impact summary: new session creation fails for some customers (token mint endpoint) — roughly 8-14% spike in 5xx depending on region. Existing sessions unaffected. CS looped in.
Priya: quick root-cause hypothesis: cloud KMS front-doors showing high tail latency; our startup path clears local/persistent cache and immediately issues blocking KMS calls with aggressive retries (linear, no jitter), causing amplified load and pod churn.
Zane: immediate mitigations we should run now: 1) pause deploys/rollback any recent rollouts that would spin up pods, 2) enable emergency fallback to our Vault HSM (local fallback for signing) for low-scope routes, 3) patch KMS client defaults (timeout + exponential backoff with jitter), 4) contact cloud providers and observability vendor.
incident-bot: action: pause-ci acknowledged. If provider case not opened in 5m, escalate to infra lead.
Mei: Paused: `argocd sync` for prod-auth and disabled auto-rollouts. Set HPA minReplicas to current for auth and web. Command used: `kubectl patch hpa auth -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`.
Zane: Opening support cases: AWS case #A-10102026, GCP case #G-10102026. Also opened a Datadog issue to check if metric ingestion delays masked early signs (Datadog case #DD-1010).
Datadog Bot: Acknowledged metric ingestion investigation. We see increased ingest latency for grpc metrics around 20:58 UTC which may have delayed automated escalation.
Priya: Good catch. That could explain why alerts escalated later. For mitigation: I'm enabling `KMS_DEGRADED_MODE=true` env which instructs services to prefer (1) disk cache, (2) Vault HSM via secure RPC, (3) KMS. Also lowering retries and increasing per-call deadline.
Zane: Hotfix config pushed as emergency env: ```
KMS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS=9000
KMS_MAX_RETRIES=3
KMS_BACKOFF=exp_jitter
KMS_DEGRADED_MODE=true
KMS_CACHE_DISK_TTL_SEC=3600
ENABLE_VAULT_HSM_FALLBACK=true
``` 
Priya: Rolling canary to 1 auth pod with Vault HSM fallback. Canary log shows: loaded key from disk cache, served sign ops, and on cache miss fetched from Vault HSM (no outbound cloud KMS calls). Canary stable for 7m.
Mei: Good. Rolling to rest of auth pods gradually. Also enabling degraded-health gating in deploy controller so new pods won't be scheduled if KMS_5xx > 0.75% for 2m.
Zane: Contacted Vault Bot: `vault-bot status`: Vault HSM cluster healthy, signing latency p95 < 10ms. Vault ready to handle extra load.
Vault Bot: Vault HSM: capacity check OK. Serving signing operations for fallback; recommended token rotation check after cutover.
Datadog Bot: Metric update: KMS 5xx and latency trending down after 12m; however ingest backlog cleared only after 8m which delayed some alerting.
Mei: CS Rep prepping customer advisory — short status sent to internal CS for review. Draft impact window: 21:02-21:34 UTC, affected flows: new token issuance and webhook verifications in affected regions. No key material exposed.
Priya: AWS support update: acknowledged elevated 5xx in us-east-1 KMS front-doors; routing reconfiguration in progress. GCP support update: ingress rebalancing applied in us-central1; both asking for conservative client retry behaviour.
Zane: Observability ops: I pushed a temporary dashboard grouping: datadog:KMS_5xx_by_region, datadog:KMS_rpc_latency_p95, auth:pod_init_backoff_count, auth:token_issue_5xx. Also added a synthetic that performs fetch-key at deploy-time to gate deploys.
Priya: After rolling fallback and config, token endpoint 5xx dropped to baseline. Unpausing deploys carefully and keeping `KMS_DEGRADED_MODE` & Vault fallback enabled until next stable release.
Mei: Post-incident action items: 1) make Vault HSM fallback official for auth-service (owner: platform/Zane), 2) change SDK defaults: timeout and exponential backoff with jitter (owner: SDK team), 3) add persistent startup key cache for all services (owner: platform), 4) update runbook to include observability vendor ingestion delays and deploy gating (owner: oncall-docs), 5) CS to send customer advisory after postmortem (owner: CS Rep).
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated; monitoring. Please file postmortem and assign owners.
Priya: I'm drafting postmortem with timeline, including note that Datadog ingestion lag delayed alerting and that our aggressive startup behavior amplified the outage. Handoff: Zane taking next oncall for 2h. Watch metrics: KMS_5xx_by_region, auth:pod_init_backoff_count, token_issue_5xx. If providers regress, reopen paging. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
